title: Universal Map world.json
description: See docs/json-reference.md for the full field-by-field reference. Mirrors the runtime checks in src/engine/manifests/app-manifest.ts (validateAppManifest) - keep both in sync when either changes.

title.description: Displayed app title. Not enforced by runtime validation, but always set it.

center.description: [lat, lng], Leaflet order - the opposite of GeoJSON coordinates, which are [lng, lat].

crs.description: Map projection. Defaults to Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) when omitted.

baseLayers.description: At least one entry required. The first element is the base layer active by default.

dataLayers.description: Relative paths to this app's layer.json files, e.g. "layers/poi.layer.json". May be empty.

system.description: Display only - storage and computation always stay Gregorian/ISO 8601. Defaults to "gregorian".

default.description: "today" seeds from the current date; otherwise an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

strings.description: Relative path (inside the app's folder) to its strings.json. If omitted, t() always falls back to the raw key.

favicon.description: Relative path (inside the world's folder) to a favicon image. If omitted, the app's default favicon (set in index.html) is kept.

primary.description: Base accent color (#rgb or #rrggbb). The darker/lighter shades used throughout the UI (--color-primary-dark/-light) are derived from it automatically (src/ui/theme.ts). If omitted, the default blue accent (styles.css) is kept.

target.description: Email, WhatsApp number (no "+"), or Telegram user/bot, depending on channel.

messageTemplate.description: Message text. "{{date}}" is replaced with the selected date (YYYY-MM-DD).

time.description: Set to false to hide all time/calendar UI (filters panel's Time section, the Map/Calendar view switcher, and Settings' calendar-system row) for a world with no temporal data. Defaults to true (time UI shown) when omitted.

welcome.description: If present, a one-way thematic splash is the initial view instead of the map — its CTA button switches to the map, nothing switches back.

heroImage.description: Relative path (inside the world's folder) to a hero image. No hero section when omitted.

itemNoun.description: Pairs with a live feature count (e.g. "8 haunted places"). No count line shown when omitted.

links.description: Plain links to other worlds (e.g. from a hub/demo world to real ones), rendered as <a href>. A real navigation/reload, not a client-side switch.

world.description: Target world id, used as ?world=<world> when "domain" is absent.

domain.description: Target world's own standalone domain (e.g. "paranormal-spain.com"), if it's deployed on one. When present, the link goes to https://<domain> instead of ?world=<world>.

labelsUrl.description: Optional second tile source rendered on top of "url" — e.g. a labels/reference layer over unlabeled satellite imagery.

labelsAttribution.description: Attribution for labelsUrl. Defaults to "attribution" when omitted.
